name: create_pull_request_inline_comment
description: Create a file-level, single-line, or line-range inline comment, optionally against a specific pull request version.

owner.description: Origin namespace (owner) slug, taken from list_namespaces or an earlier Origin result. A GitHub owner or org name is not an Origin namespace unless list_namespaces returns it.

name.description: Origin repository name within that namespace

path.description: Diff path. Deleted path for deletions; head path otherwise

side.description: left or right. Required for line and range; omit for file

startLine.description: 1-based first line. Required for line and range

endLine.description: Inclusive last line. Required for range; omit otherwise

versionNumber.description: Pull request version. Omit or 0 for latest
